verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management tool, so AI-drafted project or initiative status updates are a fair question for it. The pack shows only adjacent capabilities: manual health-status communication on projects, an MCP server that external agents can connect to, and general 'agents' marketing. None of these documents a native feature that drafts a status update from recent activity, and MCP access is a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
